name: Rio Hortega University Hospital Glioblastoma dataset
label_note: Released masks use 1/2/3; upstream preprocessing README lists enhancing tumor as BraTS label 4 — verified empirically that the distributed NIfTI masks use 3 (value 4 never appears).
geometry_note: Within each timepoint all 5 sequences + segmentation share identical grid+affine (skull-stripped, co-registered to T1ce, SRI atlas space). Most volumes are 240x240x155; RHUH-0028/0 is 230x230x138.
filename_note: One segmentation is named RHUH-0035/2/segmentation.nii.gz (non-standard) instead of RHUH-0035_2_segmentations.nii.gz; this manifest records the actual path.
